name: Boros Burn
description: Fast red damage with white interaction; tests prowess, combat and targeted spells.

name: Green Tron
description: Assemble Urza lands and cast large threats. Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying test library search.

name: Merfolk
description: Islandwalk and tribal lords build an evasive board; Aether Vial exercises activated abilities.

name: Azorius Control
description: Instant-speed answers, sweepers and planeswalkers exercise priority, stack and loyalty actions.

name: Jund Midrange
description: Discard, efficient removal and graveyard-sensitive creatures provide interactive games.

name: White Lifegain
description: Lifegain grows Pridemate and Essence Channeler; an accessible deck for checking simultaneous triggers.

name: Blue Tempo
description: Evasive threats backed by counters and bounce; teaches stack interaction and combat timing.

name: Black Midrange
description: Removal, card draw and resilient creatures; death triggers and sacrifice choices matter.

name: Red Aggro
description: Low-cost attackers, burn and prowess provide a fast bot opponent without banned red staples.

name: Green Stompy
description: Mana creatures accelerate large tramplers; combat and permanent abilities drive the game.

name: Izzet Phoenix
description: Mandatory Phoenix deck: cantrips and graveyard setup return Arclight Phoenix automatically at combat.

name: Lotus Field Combo
description: Mandatory Lotus Field deck: copy Lotus Field with Thespian's Stage, untap for mana, tutor and win with Approach.

name: Rakdos Midrange
description: Discard and removal support value creatures, Fable chapters and Blood tokens.

name: White Humans
description: A tribal curve with Thalia taxes, lieutenant counters and Brave the Elements combat finishes.

name: Azorius Spirits
description: Flash and flying threats combine with lord bonuses and protective spirits.

name: Giada Angels
description: Mono-white Angels. Giada adds counters as Angels enter; life and combat triggers test the full rules engine.

name: Talrand Spells
description: Mono-blue spells create Drake tokens, then protect an evasive army. Draw, scry, counterspells and trigger ordering.

name: Ayara Devotion
description: Mono-black devotion and sacrifice. Enter, death and life-drain triggers create an engine-driven value loop.

name: Krenko Goblins
description: Mono-red Goblins create tokens, attack and sacrifice for damage. Many simultaneous enter/death triggers.

name: Goreclaw Stompy
description: Mono-green ramp and large creatures. Cost reductions, trample, fight and draw triggers reward attacking.
